english:
PRIVACY POLICY

Double Dealers — Developed by Miklagard Studios
Last updated: July 14, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains what data Double Dealers ("the Game") processes, why, and what your choices are. We designed the Game to collect as little data as possible.


1. SUMMARY

- The Game does not collect names, Steam IDs, IP addresses, chat messages, voice recordings, or any other personally identifying information in its diagnostic reports.
- Diagnostic reporting is optional and off by default. It only activates if you explicitly accept it, and you can turn it off at any time in Settings.
- Reports are delivered via Discord's webhook service. As with any internet request, Discord's servers technically process your IP address to deliver the data. We never see, receive, or store your IP address, and we do not share any personal data with Discord or any other third parties.


2. OPTIONAL DIAGNOSTIC REPORTS (OPT-IN)

If — and only if — you give consent, the Game will send a diagnostic report to the developer when an unexpected disconnection occurs during multiplayer play. This helps us identify and fix connection and stability problems.

What a report contains:
- Game version, current scene name, and a UTC timestamp
- A technical disconnect reason code (for example "Timeout" or "HostLeft")
- Filtered technical log lines from the game's own log file, limited to network diagnostics (ping, connection quality, packet statistics), netcode/transport status messages, and error entries consisting only of an exception type and the code location where it occurred
- A random session identifier, regenerated every time the Game starts. It is not derived from your identity and cannot be linked back to you; it only lets us tell whether two reports in the same play session came from the same game instance.
- General hardware and system specifications (such as CPU, GPU, RAM models, and operating system version) to help debug performance and crash issues.

What a report never contains:
Reports are processed through an anonymization system that completely filters out personal information, ensuring that no personally identifiable data is ever collected. This system includes a masking layer that automatically removes patterns such as Steam IDs, player names, file paths containing usernames, and IP addresses. Reports never include:
- Player names or Steam account information
- Chat messages or voice data
- Absolute local file paths (such as directories containing your personal PC username)
- Unique hardware identifiers (such as MAC addresses or HWIDs) or operating-system account details
- Any free-form text entered by you or other players

How reports are delivered:
Reports are sent from your device to a private Discord channel using Discord's webhook service (Discord Inc., USA). Because the report travels over the internet, Discord processes your device's IP address as a technical part of receiving the request, subject to Discord's own Privacy Policy (discord.com/privacy). While your IP address is technically transmitted to Discord in order to establish the network connection, we do not share any of your personal data with them. The IP address is not part of the report content, is not visible to the developer, and is not stored by us.

Consent and control:
- On first launch you are asked whether to enable diagnostic reporting. If you decline, nothing is ever sent.
- You can enable or disable reporting at any time in Settings under the Game tab. Disabling it takes effect immediately.
- Reporting is limited to a small number of reports per game session.


3. DATA STORED LOCALLY ON YOUR DEVICE

The Game stores settings (resolution, volume, language, your consent choice, etc.) locally on your device using Unity's PlayerPrefs and standard log files. This data never leaves your device except as described in Section 2.


4. THIRD-PARTY SERVICES

Steam (Valve Corporation): The Game runs on Steam and uses Steamworks for multiplayer (lobbies, matchmaking, peer-to-peer relay networking) and for displaying player names and avatars to other players in your lobby. This is governed by Valve's Privacy Policy (store.steampowered.com/privacy_agreement). The Game does not transmit Steam data to the developer.

Discord (Discord Inc.): Used solely as the delivery channel for optional diagnostic reports, as described in Section 2.

We do not use analytics SDKs, advertising networks, or tracking of any kind.


5. DATA RETENTION

Diagnostic reports are kept only as long as needed to investigate and fix the related issue, after which they are deleted. Because reports contain no personal identifiers, we cannot look up, modify, or delete a report tied to a specific person.


6. CHILDREN

The Game does not knowingly collect personal data from anyone, including children. Diagnostic reports contain no personal information regardless of the player's age.


7. LEGAL BASES (EU/EEA AND SIMILAR JURISDICTIONS)

Where data protection law applies (for example GDPR or KVKK), optional diagnostic reporting is based on your consent, which you may withdraw at any time via Settings. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal. Since reports contain no personal data, most data-subject rights (access, rectification, erasure of a specific report) cannot be technically fulfilled for report content, as we cannot identify which reports, if any, originate from you.


8. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY

We may update this policy as the Game evolves. Material changes will be indicated by the "Last updated" date above and, where appropriate, announced in the Game or on its store page.


9. CONTACT

For questions about this policy or data practices:
contact@miklagardstudio.com
Miklagard Studios
korean:
개인정보 처리방침

Double Dealers — Developed by Miklagard Studios
최근 수정일: 2026년 7월 14일

본 개인정보 처리방침은 Double Dealers("본 게임")가 어떤 데이터를 처리하고, 그 이유는 무엇이며, 귀하의 선택권은 무엇인지 설명합니다. 저희는 본 게임이 가능한 한 최소한의 데이터만 수집하도록 설계했습니다.


1. 요약

- 본 게임은 진단 보고서에서 이름, Steam ID, IP 주소, 채팅 메시지, 음성 녹음 또는 기타 개인을 식별할 수 있는 정보를 수집하지 않습니다.
- 진단 보고는 선택 사항이며 기본적으로 비활성화되어 있습니다. 귀하가 명시적으로 동의하는 경우에만 활성화되며, 설정에서 언제든지 비활성화할 수 있습니다.
- 보고서는 Discord의 웹훅(webhook) 서비스를 통해 전달됩니다. 모든 인터넷 요청과 마찬가지로, Discord의 서버는 데이터를 전달하기 위해 기술적으로 귀하의 IP 주소를 처리합니다. 저희는 귀하의 IP 주소를 확인, 수신 또는 저장하지 않으며, Discord 또는 기타 제3자에게 개인 데이터를 공유하지 않습니다.


2. 선택적 진단 보고 (동의 기반)

귀하가 동의하는 경우에 한하여, 멀티플레이어 플레이 중 예상치 못한 연결 끊김이 발생할 때 본 게임은 개발자에게 진단 보고서를 전송합니다. 이는 저희가 연결 및 안정성 문제를 파악하고 해결하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

보고서 포함 내용:
- 게임 버전, 현재 씬(scene) 이름 및 UTC 타임스탬프
- 기술적인 연결 끊김 원인 코드 (예: "Timeout" 또는 "HostLeft")
- 게임 자체의 로그 파일에서 필터링된 기술 로그 라인. 이는 네트워크 진단(핑, 연결 품질, 패킷 통계), 넷코드/트랜스포트 상태 메시지 및 예외 유형과 오류가 발생한 코드 위치만으로 구성된 오류 항목에 국한됩니다.
